metadata.question: Does the surface water extent along the Lower Mississippi River (e.g., Arkansas City, Arkansas; Vicksburg, Mississippi; Natchez, Mississippi) increase in March 19, 2019 compared to March 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection, or Landsat/Sentinel-2 with water indices (NDWI/MNDWI) - Date: March 19, 2019 vs March 19, 2017 (exact dates or small window ±3 days) - Location: Lower Mississippi River near Arkansas City, AR; Vicksburg, MS; Natchez, MS - I'll use multiple points along the river and create a region of interest 2. Masking strategy: - For optical data (Landsat/Sentinel-2): Use cloud masking, then calculate MNDWI or NDWI - For SAR (Sentinel-1): Water appears dark in VV polarization - JRC Surface Water: Already processed water occurrence/extent data - I'll use Sentinel-1 SAR as it works through clouds and is good for water detection 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Check collection size for both dates - Check pixel counts after processing - Compare water extent (pixel count or area) between 2017 and 2019 - Valid result: both dates have data and valid pixels - C1: No images for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: 2019 water extent > 2017 - B: 2019 water extent <= 2017 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region along Lower Mississippi River const arkansasCity = ee.Geometry.Point([-91.2068, 33.6076]); const vicksburg = ee.Geometry.Point([-90.8779, 32.3526]); const natchez = ee.Geometry.Point([-91.4032, 31.5604]); // Create buffer around these points to cover river corridor const roi = ee.FeatureCollection([ ee.Feature(arkansasCity.buffer(15000)), ee.Feature(vicksburg.buffer(15000)), ee.Feature(natchez.buffer(15000)) ]).geometry().dissolve(); // 2. Get Sentinel-1 SAR data for both dates (±5 days window) const date2017Start = '2017-03-14'; const date2017End = '2017-03-24'; const date2019Start = '2019-03-14'; const date2019End = '2019-03-24'; let col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2017Start, date2017End) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')); let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2019Start, date2019End) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Process water detection (VV < -15 dB typically indicates water) const img2017 = col2017.select('VV').median(); const img2019 = col2019.select('VV').median(); const waterThreshold = -15; const water2017 = img2017.lt(waterThreshold); const water2019 = img2019.lt(waterThreshold); // 4. Calculate water extent (pixel count and area) const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const stats2017 = water2017.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2019 = water2019.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2017 = water2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2017 = stats2017.get('VV').getInfo(); const area2019 = stats2019.get('VV').getInfo(); const pixels2017 = count2017.get('VV').getInfo(); const pixels2019 = count2019.get('VV').getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Water Pixels: ${pixels2017}, Area: ${(area2017/1e6).toFixed(2)} km2`); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${pixels2019}, Area: ${(area2019/1e6).toFixed(2)} km2`); // 5. Validation and answer if (area2017 === null || area2019 === null || pixels2017 === null || pixels2019 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (pixels2017 === 0 || pixels2019 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels detected"); console.log("C2"); return; } if (area2019 > area2017) { console.log(`Water extent increased by ${((area2019-area2017)/1e6).toFixed(2)} km2`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Water extent decreased or unchanged by ${((area2017-area2019)/1e6).toFixed(2)} km2`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
